correctness.rationale: For a strictly positive periodic orbit, integrating the logarithmic prey equation gives \(\bar x+\bar y=1\); integrating the predator equation and shifting a periodic integrand gives \(\overline{xy}=x_*\bar y\); integrating the prey equation then yields the exact second-moment factorization. Covariance follows algebraically, and Cauchy–Schwarz with its equality condition gives strict predator-variance dominance for every nonconstant orbit. No asymptotic or numerical approximation enters the proof.

value.rationale: The motivating source has coexisting stable cycles, long-period branches, period doubling, and chaos. The theorem gives exact finite-amplitude quantities for every positive periodic branch, independent of proximity to Hopf: a strict prey-mean uplift, predator-mean deficit, an exact prey-variance shell, perfect covariance calibration, and strict predator-variance dominance. These are quantitative constraints that can check or interpret continuation/simulation data for distinct cycles at the same delay and are not supplied by local bifurcation theory alone.
